description.subject: A hand-stitched yarn doll with a round white head, standing as a small toy figure.
description.covering: A red hooded jacket with long sleeves, patch pockets and a single round yellow button, worn over blue trousers that reach the ankles, with yellow boots and white mitten-like hands.
description.posture: It stands on both feet with its arms hanging slightly out from its sides, turned toward the viewer with its head level.
description.light: Even, gentle, pale white light with no hard shadows, coming from the front and slightly above, with a faint shadow pooled to the right of the feet.
description.materials: Knotted yarn in red, white, blue and yellow, a plastic or glass button, stitched thread for the mouth and lashes, and a smooth pale tabletop and backdrop.
description.anomaly: Wavy white zigzag stitching outlines the hood edge, pockets, cuffs and hem of the jacket, and a matching white and yellow zigzag band wraps around the top of each boot.
